s.d: προ-κυρόω, -ῶ to establish or confirm beforehand: [[galatians 3 17|Gal.3:17.]]† (AS)

προ-λαμβάνω [in LXX: Wis.17:11 א2, Wis.17:17 א2B * ;] 1. to take beforehand: with accusative, [[1-corinthians 11 21|1Co.11:21]] (but see infr.). 2. to be beforehand, anticipate (in cl., with accusative, genitive or dative): with inf. (= cl. φθάνω, see Bl., § 69, 4; Swete, in l), [[mark 14 8|Mrk.14:8.]] 3. to overtake, surprise: pass., [[galatians 6 1|Gal.6:1]] (on the virtual disappearance of the temporal force of the preposi­tion in this compound here and perhaps also in 1Co, l.with, see MM, xxi).† (AS)

προ-λέγω [in LXX: [[isaiah 41 26|Isa.41:26]] (נָגַד hi.) * ;] 1. to tell or say before­hand: [[2-corinthians 13 2|2Co.13:2]], [[galatians 5 21|Gal.5:21]], [[1-thessalonians 3 4|1Th.3:4]] (R, txt.; cf. προεῖπον, but see infr.). 2. to declare, tell plainly: 2Co, Ga, 1Th, ll. with (R, mg.; see MM, xxi, and cf. Isa, l.with).† (AS)
προ-μαρτύρομαι to protest beforehand (cf. μαρτύρομαι, and V. Hort, in l): [[1-peter 1 11|1Pe.1:11]] (elsewhere only in Theod. Met., xiv/AD.).† (AS)
to practise beforehand : with infinitive, (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)
προ-μεριμνάω, -ῶ to be anxious beforehand: [[mark 13 11|Mrk.13:11.]]† (AS)

προ-μοέω, -ῶ and depon. -έομαι, οῦμαι, [in LXX: Dan LXX 11:37 (בִּין), Wis.6:7, al. ;] 1. to foresee. 2. to provide (RV, take thought for): with accusative of thing(s), καλά, [[romans 12 17|Rom.12:17]] (-ούμενοι), [[2-corinthians 8 21|2Co.8:21]] (-οῦμεν). 3. to provide for (before περί, Wis, l.with): with genitive of person(s), [[1-timothy 5 8|1Ti.5:8]] (-εῖ, WH, mg., -εῖται).† (AS)

πρόνοια, -ας, ἡ (πρόνοος, careful) [in LXX: Dan LXX 6:18 (19) Wis.14:3 17:2, 4Mac.6:1-35 * ;] foresight, forethought: [[acts 24 3|Act.24:3;]] π. ποιεῖσθαι, with genitive (Dem., 546, 6), make provision for, show care for: [[romans 13 14|Rom.13:14.]]† (AS)

προ-οράω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[psalms 16 8|Psa.16:8]]) (שָׁוָה pi.), I [[esther 5 63|Est.5:63]] A * ;] to see before (as to place or time): with accusative, [[acts 21 29|Act.21:29.]] Mid., with accusative, before ἐνώπιόν μου, [[acts 2 25|Act.2:25]] (LXX).† (AS)

προ-ορίζω to predetermine, foreordain: with accusative, [[romans 8 30|Rom.8:30;]] id. and inf., [[acts 4 28|Act.4:28;]] id. before εἰς, [[1-corinthians 2 7|1Co.2:7]], [[ephesians 1 5|Eph.1:5]]; with dupl. accusative, [[romans 8 26|Rom.8:26;]] pass., [[ephesians 1 11|Eph.1:11.]]† (AS)
to suffer first or beforehand , (Herdotus Historicus), etc.: to be ill-treated before , ὑπό τινος (Thucydides):—;also, ἀγαθὸν πρ. (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

προ-πέμπω [in LXX: I [[esther 4 47|Est.4:47]], Jdth.10:15, Wis.19:2, 1Ma.12:4, 2Ma.6:23 * ;] 1. to send before, send forth. 2. to set forward on a journey, escort: with accusative of person(s), [[1-corinthians 16 11|1Co.16:11]], [[titus 3 13|Tit.3:13]], 3Jn.6; before εἰς, [[acts 20 38|Act.20:38;]] οὗ, [[1-corinthians 16 6|1Co.16:6;]] ἕως, [[acts 21 5|Act.21:5;]] pass., [[acts 15 3|Act.15:3]], [[romans 15 24|Rom.15:24]], [[2-corinthians 1 16|2Co.1:16]].† (AS)

προπετής, -ές (προπίπτω), [in LXX: [[proverbs 10 14|Pro.10:14]] (אֱוִיל) [[proverbs 13 3|Pro.13:3]] (פָּשַׂק) Sir.9:18 * ;] falling forwards, headlong. Metaphorical, precipitate, rash, reck­less: of persons, [[2-timothy 3 4|2Ti.3:4;]] of things, [[acts 19 36|Act.19:36.]]† (AS)
προ-πορεύω [in LXX chiefly for הָלַךְ, also for עָבַר, etc. ;] to make to go before. Pass. and mid., to go before: [[luke 1 76|Luk.1:76]], [[acts 7 40|Act.7:40]]" (LXX) ,† (AS)

πρός, prep. with genitive, dative, accusative I. I. C. genitive, of motion from a place, from the side of, hence metaphorically, in the interests of, [[acts 27 34|Act.27:34]] (cf. Page, in l.). II. II. C. dative, of local proximity, hard by, near, at: [[mark 5 11|Mrk.5:11]], [[luke 19 37|Luk.19:37]], [[john 18 16|Jhn.18:16 20:11, 12]] [[revelation 1 13|Rev.1:13]]. III. C. accusative, of motion or direction towards a place or object, to, towards. 1. Of place, (a) after verbs of motion or of speaking and other words with the idea of direction: ἔρχομαι, ἀναβαίνω, πορεύομαι, λέγω, ἐπιστολή, etc., [[matthew 3 14|Mat.3:14]], [[mark 6 51|Mrk.6:51]], [[luke 11 5|Luk.11:5]], [[john 2 3|Jhn.2:3]], [[acts 9 2|Act.9:2]], al. mult.; metaphorically, of mental direction, hostile or otherwise, [[luke 23 12|Luk.23:12]], [[john 6 52|Jhn.6:52]], [[2-corinthians 7 4|2Co.7:4]], [[ephesians 6 12|Eph.6:12]], [[colossians 3 13|Col.3:13]], al.; of the issue or end, [[luke 14 32|Luk.14:32]], [[john 11 4|Jhn.11:4]], al.; of purpose, [[matthew 26 12|Mat.26:12]], [[romans 3 26|Rom.3:26]], [[1-corinthians 6 5|1Co.6:5]], al.; πρὸς τό, with inf., denoting purpose (cf. M, Pr., 218, 220; Lft., Notes, 131), [[matthew 5 28|Mat.5:28]], [[mark 13 22|Mrk.13:22]], [[ephesians 6 11|Eph.6:11]], [[1-thessalonians 2 9|1Th.2:9]], al.; (b) of close proximity, at, by, with: [[matthew 3 10|Mat.3:10]], [[mark 11 4|Mrk.11:4]], [[luke 4 11|Luk.4:11]], [[acts 3 2|Act.3:2]], al.; after εἶναι, [[matthew 13 56|Mat.13:56]], [[mark 6 3|Mrk.6:3]], [[john 1 1|Jhn.1:1]], al. 2. 2. Of time, (a) towards (Plat., Xen., LXX: [[genesis 8 11|Gen.8:11]], al.): [[luke 24 29|Luk.24:29]]; (b) for: πρὸς καιρόν, [[luke 8 13|Luk.8:13]], [[1-corinthians 7 5|1Co.7:5]]; πρὸς ὥραν, [[john 5 35|Jhn.5:35]], al.; πρὸς ὀλίγον, [[james 4 14|Jas.4:14.]] 3. Of relation (a) toward, with: [[romans 5 1|Rom.5:1]], [[2-corinthians 1 12|2Co.1:12]], [[colossians 4 5|Col.4:5]], [[1-thessalonians 4 12|1Th.4:12]], al.; (b) with regard to: [[matthew 19 8|Mat.19:8]], [[mark 12 12|Mrk.12:12]], [[romans 8 31|Rom.8:31]], al.; (with) pertaining to, to: [[matthew 27 4|Mat.27:4]], [[john 21 22|Jhn.21:22]], [[romans 15 17|Rom.15:17]], [[hebrews 2 17|Heb.2:17 5:1]]; (d) according to: [[luke 12 47|Luk.12:47]], [[2-corinthians 5 10|2Co.5:10]], [[galatians 2 14|Gal.2:14]], [[ephesians 3 4|Eph.3:4 4:14]]; (e) in comparison with: [[romans 8 18|Rom.8:18.]] IV. In composition: towards (προσέρχομαι), to (προσάγω), against (προσκόπτω), besides (προσδαπανάω) . (AS)

προ-σάββατον, -ου, τό [in LXX: [[psalms 92 1|Psa.92:1-15]] title. א (שַׁבָּת) שַׁבָּת) [[psalms 93 1|Psa.93:1-5]] title., Jdth.8:6 * ;] the day before the Sabbath: [[mark 15 42|Mrk.15:42]] (L, Tr., txt., πρὸς σ.).† (AS)

προσ-αγορεύω [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 23 6|Deu.23:6]] (7) (דָּרַשׁ), ?[[esther 10 11|Est.10:11]] (יָדָה hith.), Wis.14:22, 1Ma.14:40, 2Ma.1:36 2Mac 4:7 2Mac 10:9 2Mac 14:37 * ;] to address, greet, salute; hence, to call by name, address, style: with dupl. accusative, pass., [[hebrews 5 10|Heb.5:10.]]† (AS)

προσ-άγω [in LXX chiefly for = קָרַב hi., also for נָגַשׁ etc. ;] 1. trans., to bring or lead: with accusative and dative, [[acts 16 20|Act.16:20;]] metaphorically, τ. θεῷ, [[1-peter 3 18|1Pe.3:18;]] before ὧδε, [[luke 9 41|Luk.9:41;]] pass., with dative, [[matthew 18 24|Mat.18:24]] (προσηνέχθη, T); in forensic sense, to summon: [[acts 12 6|Act.12:6]] (προαγαγεῖν, T, WH, mg., R). 2. Intrans., to draw near, approach ([[joshua 3 9|Jos.3:9]], [[jeremiah 26 3|Jer.26:3]] ([[jeremiah 46 3|Jer.46:3]]), al.): with dative, [[acts 27 27|Act.27:27]] (WH, προσαχεῖν).† (AS)

προσ-αγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ (προσάγω), 1. a bringing to. 2. approach, access (see Lft., Notes, 284; MM, xxi): [[romans 5 2|Rom.5:2]], [[ephesians 2 18|Eph.2:18 3:12]] (but see Ellic., Eph., 59 f., where the transitive sense "introduction " is advocated).† (AS)
προσ-αιτέω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[job 27 14|Job.27:14]] * ;] 1. to ask besides. 2. to continue asking; hence, to importune, beg, ask alms: [[john 9 8|Jhn.9:8.]]† (AS)
προσ-ανα-βαίνω [in LXX: [[exodus 19 23|Exo.19:23]], al. (עָלָה) ;] 1. to go up besides. 2. to go up higher: [[luke 14 10|Luk.14:10.]]† (AS)
προσ-αναλίσκω to spend besides: [[luke 8 43|Luk.8:43]] (WH, R, mg., om.).† (AS)
προσ-αναπληρόω, -ῶ [in LXX: Wis.19:4 * ;] to fill up by adding to, to supply fully: [[2-corinthians 9 12|2Co.9:12 11:9]].† (AS)

προσ-ανα-τίθημι to lay on or offer besides; mid., (a) to lay on oneself in addition, undertake besides; (b) with genitive of person(s), of giving or obtaining information, to consult, communicate: [[galatians 1 16|Gal.1:16 2:6]] (Lft., in l; cf. ἀνα-τίθημι) (AS)
προσ-απειλέω, -ῶ [in LXX: Sir.13:3 א * ;] to threaten further: [[acts 4 21|Act.4:21.]]† (AS)
προσδαπανάω, -ῶ to spend besides: with accusative, [[luke 10 35|Luk.10:35.]]† SYN.: προσαναλίσκω (AS)
προσ-δέομαι [in LXX: [[proverbs 12 9|Pro.12:9]] חָסֵר חָסֵר Sir.6:1-37 * ;] to want further, need in addition: [[acts 17 25|Act.17:25.]]† (AS)

προσ-δέχομαι [in LXX chiefly for רָצָה ;] 1. to receive to oneself, receive favourably, admit, accept: with accusative of person(s), [[luke 15 2|Luk.15:2]], [[romans 16 2|Rom.16:2]], [[philippians 2 29|Php.2:29]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[acts 24 15|Act.24:15]] (R, mg.), [[hebrews 10 34|Heb.10:34 11:35]]. 2. to expect, look for, wait for: with accusative of person(s), [[luke 12 36|Luk.12:36;]] with accusative of thing(s), [[mark 15 43|Mrk.15:43]], [[luke 2 25|Luk.2:25, 38 23:51]], [[acts 23 21|Act.23:21]], [[titus 2 13|Tit.2:13]], Ju 21 (cf. δέχομαι).† (AS)

προσ-δοκάω, -ῶ (the simple verb exists only in the forms δοκέω, -εύω) [in LXX: [[psalms 104 27|Psa.104:27]] (שָׂבַר pi.), etc. ;] to await, expect: [[matthew 24 50|Mat.24:50]], [[luke 3 15|Luk.3:15 12:46]], [[acts 27 33|Act.27:33 28:6]]; with accusative of person(s), [[matthew 11 3|Mat.11:3]], [[luke 1 21|Luk.1:21 7:19-20 8:40]] [[acts 10 24|Act.10:24]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[2-peter 3 12|2Pe.3:12-14;]] with accusative and inf., [[acts 28 6|Act.28:6;]] with inf., [[acts 3 5|Act.3:5.]]† (AS)

προσδοκία, -ας, ἡ (ιροσδοκάω), [in LXX: [[genesis 49 10|Gen.49:10]] (יִקָּהָה), [[psalms 119 116|Psa.119:116]] (שֵׂבֶר) Wis.17:13, Sir.40:2, al. ;] expectation: with genitive obj., [[luke 21 26|Luk.21:26;]] with genitive subjc., [[acts 12 11|Act.12:11.]]† (AS)
to suffer to go further , τινά (New Testament) (ML)
προσ-εγγίζω [in LXX chiefly for נָגַשׁ, קָרַב ;] 1. trans., to bring near (Luc.). 2. Intrans., to approach: with dative, [[mark 2 4|Mrk.2:4]] (WH, προσενέγκαι).† (AS)

προσεδρεύω (πρόσεδρος, sitting near), [in LXX: 1Ma.11:40 * ;] 1. to sit near. 2. to attend regularly: with dative, [[1-corinthians 9 13|1Co.9:13]], Rec. (see: παρεδρεύω).† παρ-εδρεύω [in LXX: [[proverbs 1 21|Pro.1:21 8:3]] * ;] to sit constantly beside, attend constantly (cf. MM, xix): τ. θυσιαστηρίω, [[1-corinthians 9 13|1Co.9:13.]]† (AS)
προσ-εργάζομαι 1. to work or do service besides (Hdt., Plut.). 2. to gain besides, by working or trading: [[luke 19 16|Luk.19:16]] (Xen.).† (AS)

προσ-έρχομαι [in LXX for קָרַב, נָגַשׁ, etc. ;] to approach, draw near: absol., [[matthew 4 11|Mat.4:11]], [[luke 9 42|Luk.9:42]], al.; with infin., [[matthew 24 1|Mat.24:1]], al.; with dative loc., [[hebrews 12 18|Heb.12:18, 22]]; dative of person(s), [[matthew 5 1|Mat.5:1]], and freq., [[john 12 21|Jhn.12:21]], al.; ptcp., προσελθών, with indic., [[matthew 8 2|Mat.8:2]], and freq., [[mark 1 31|Mrk.1:31]], [[luke 7 14|Luk.7:14]], al.; π. αὐτῷ, with indic., [[matthew 4 3|Mat.4:3]], [[mark 6 35|Mrk.6:35]], Metaphorical, (a) of approaching God: absol. ([[leviticus 21 17|Lev.21:17]], [[deuteronomy 21 5|Deu.21:5]], al.), [[hebrews 10 1|Heb.10:1, 22]]; τ. θεῷ, [[hebrews 7 25|Heb.7:25 11:6]]; τ. θρόνῳ τ. χάριτος, [[hebrews 4 16|Heb.4:16;]] πρὸς Χριστόν, [[1-peter 2 4|1Pe.2:4;]] (b) in sense not found elsewhere (Field, Notes, 211), to consent to: ὑγιαίνουσι λόγοις, [[1-timothy 6 3|1Ti.6:3]] (AS)

προσ-ευχή, -ῆς, ἡ (προσεύχομαι), [in LXX chiefly for תְּפִלָּה ;] 1. prayer to God: [[matthew 17 21|Mat.17:21]] (WH, R, txt., om.) [[matthew 21 22|Mat.21:22]], [[mark 9 29|Mrk.9:29]], [[luke 22 45|Luk.22:45]], [[acts 3 1|Act.3:1 6:4 10:31]], [[romans 12 12|Rom.12:12]], [[1-corinthians 7 5|1Co.7:5]], [[colossians 4 2|Col.4:2]]; pl., [[acts 2 42|Act.2:42 10:4]], [[romans 1 10|Rom.1:10]], [[ephesians 1 16|Eph.1:16]] [[colossians 4 12|Col.4:12]], [[1-thessalonians 1 2|1Th.1:2]], Phm 4 22, [[1-peter 3 7|1Pe.3:7 4:7]], [[revelation 5 8|Rev.5:8 8:3-4]]; οἶκος προσευχῆς, [[matthew 21 13|Mat.21:13]], [[mark 11 17|Mrk.11:17]], [[luke 19 46|Luk.19:46]]" (LXX) ; π. καὶ δέησις, [[ephesians 6 18|Eph.6:18]], [[philippians 4 6|Php.4:6]]; pl., [[1-timothy 2 1|1Ti.2:1 5:5]]; ἡ π. τοῦ θεοῦ, prayer to God (ef. Wis.16:28), [[luke 6 12|Luk.6:12]]; πρὸς τ. θεόν, before ὑπέρ, [[acts 12 5|Act.12:5;]] pl., [[romans 15 30|Rom.15:30;]] Hebraistically (B1., § 38, 3), προσευχῇ προσεύχεσθαι, [[james 5 17|Jas.5:17]] (EV, prayed fervently). 2. a place of prayer: of a synagogue (3Ma.7:20, seel.; see Charles, APOT, i, 173; for other exx., see Kennedy, Sources, 114); of a place in the open (FlJ, Ant., xiv, 10, 23), [[acts 16 13|Act.16:13, 16]].† SYN.: see: δέησις (AS)

προσ-εύχομαι [in LXX chiefly for פָּלַל hith. ;] to pray (always of prayer to God, or in cl., to gods): absol., [[matthew 6 5|Mat.6:5-7, 9 14:23 19:13 26:36, 39 26:41, 44]], [[mark 1 35|Mrk.1:35 6:46 11:24-25 13:33]] (WH, E, txt., om.) [[mark 14 32|Mrk.14:32, 38-39]] [[luke 1 10|Luk.1:10 3:21 5:16 6:12 9:18, 28-29 11:1-2 18:1, 10 22:44]] (WH, E, mg., om.), [[acts 1 24|Act.1:24 6:6 9:11 10:9, 30 11:5 12:12 13:3 14:23 16:25 20:36 21:5 22:17 28:8]], [[1-corinthians 11 4|1Co.11:4-5 14:14]], [[1-thessalonians 5 17|1Th.5:17]], [[1-timothy 2 8|1Ti.2:8]], [[james 5 13|Jas.5:13, 18]]; before λέγων, [[matthew 26 39|Mat.26:39, 42]], [[luke 22 41|Luk.22:41]]; with dative instr., [[1-corinthians 11 5|1Co.11:5 14:14-15]]; μακρά, [[matthew 23 14|Mat.23:14]] (WH, R, txt., om.), [[mark 12 40|Mrk.12:40]], [[luke 20 47|Luk.20:47]]; ἐν πνεύματι (ἁγίῳ), [[ephesians 6 18|Eph.6:18]], Ju 20; προσευχῇ π. (a Hebraism, see: προσευχή), [[james 5 17|Jas.5:17;]] with accusative of thing(s), [[luke 18 11|Luk.18:11]], [[romans 8 26|Rom.8:26]]; before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), [[james 5 14|Jas.5:14;]] with dative of person(s), [[matthew 6 6|Mat.6:6]], [[1-corinthians 11 13|1Co.11:13]]; before περί, with genitive, [[acts 8 15|Act.8:15]], [[colossians 1 3|Col.1:3 4:3]], [[1-thessalonians 5 25|1Th.5:25]], [[2-thessalonians 1 11|2Th.1:11 3:1]], [[hebrews 13 18|Heb.13:18]]; ὑπέρ, [[matthew 5 44|Mat.5:44]] [[luke 6 28|Luk.6:28]], [[colossians 1 9|Col.1:9]], [[james 5 16|Jas.5:16]]; before ἵνα, [[matthew 24 20|Mat.24:20]], [[mark 13 18|Mrk.13:18 14:35]], [[luke 22 46|Luk.22:46]], [[1-corinthians 14 13|1Co.14:13]]; τοῦτο ἵνα, [[philippians 1 9|Php.1:9;]] with inf., [[luke 22 46|Luk.22:46;]] before τοῦ, with inf. (Bl., § 71, 3), [[james 5 17|Jas.5:17.]]† (AS)

προσ-έχω [in LXX for קָשַׁב hi., שָׁמַר ni., etc. ;] 1. to turn to, bring to (frequently ναῦν, expressed or understood, to bring to port, land; Hdt., al.). 2. τ. νοῦν, before dative, to turn one's mind to, attend to; in Xen. and later writers with νοῦν omitted (El., § 53, 1; 81, 1): [[acts 8 6|Act.8:6 16:14]], [[hebrews 2 1|Heb.2:1]], [[2-peter 1 19|2Pe.1:19]]; in sense of caring or providing for, [[acts 20 28|Act.20:28;]] π. ἑαυτῷ, to give heed to oneself (M, Pr., 157; cf. [[genesis 24 6|Gen.24:6]], [[exodus 10 28|Exo.10:28]], al.): [[luke 17 3|Luk.17:3 21:34]], [[acts 5 35|Act.5:35]]; id. before ἀπό (M, Pr., 102; B1., § 34, 11; 40, 3; see: βλέπω), [[luke 12 1|Luk.12:1;]] (without dative) [[matthew 7 15|Mat.7:15 10:17 16:6, 11-12]], [[luke 20 46|Luk.20:46]] (cf. Sir.6:13, al.); before μή, with inf. (M, Pr., 193; Bl., § 69, 4), [[matthew 6 1|Mat.6:1.]] 3. to attach or devote oneself to: with dative of person(s), [[acts 8 10|Act.8:10-11]], [[1-timothy 4 1|1Ti.4:1]]; with dative of thing(s), [[1-timothy 1 4|1Ti.1:4 3:8 4:13 6:3]] T (-ερχ-, WH, R), [[titus 1 14|Tit.1:14]], [[hebrews 7 13|Heb.7:13]].† (AS)
προσ-ηλόω -ῶ [in LXX: 3Ma.4:9 * ;] to nail to: with accusative and dative, figuratively, [[colossians 2 14|Col.2:14.]]† (AS)

προσήλυτος, -ον (προοελαύνω), [in LXX for גֵּר ;] 1. one who has arrived, a stranger. 2. Of converts to Judaism, a proselyte (see DB, see word): [[matthew 23 15|Mat.23:15]], [[acts 2 10|Act.2:10 6:5 13:43]].† (AS)

πρόσ-καιρος, -ον [in LXX: 4Ma.15:2 4Mac 15:8 4Mac 15:23 * ;] 1. in season. 2. for a season, temporary, transient: [[2-corinthians 4 18|2Co.4:18]], [[hebrews 11 25|Heb.11:25]]; of plants, short-lived: [[matthew 13 21|Mat.13:21]], [[mark 4 17|Mrk.4:17]].† (AS)

προσ-καλέω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;] to call to. Mid., to call to oneself (see M, Pr., 157): with accusative of person(s), [[matthew 10 1|Mat.10:1]], [[mark 3 13|Mrk.3:13 6:7]], [[luke 7 19|Luk.7:19]], [[acts 5 40|Act.5:40]], [[james 5 14|Jas.5:14]], al. Metaphorical, of the Divine call: [[acts 2 39|Act.2:39;]] with inf., [[acts 16 10|Act.16:10]] (see Bl., § 69, 4); before εἰς, [[acts 13 2|Act.13:2.]]† (AS)

προσ-καρτερέω, -ῶ (καρτερός, strong, stedfast) [in LXX: [[numbers 13 21|Num.13:21]] (חָזַק hith.), Tob.5:8 א, Da Th Su 1:6* ;] to attend constantly, continue stedfastly, adhere to, wait on: with dative of person(s), [[mark 3 9|Mrk.3:9]], [[acts 8 13|Act.8:13 10:7]]; with dative of thing(s), [[acts 1 14|Act.1:14 2:42 6:4]], [[romans 12 12|Rom.12:12]], [[colossians 4 2|Col.4:2]]; before ἐν, [[acts 2 46|Act.2:46;]] εἰς, [[romans 13 6|Rom.13:6.]]† (AS)
προσ-καρτέρησις, -εως, ἡ (προσκαρτερέω) stedfastness, persever­ance: [[ephesians 6 18|Eph.6:18.]]† (AS)
προσ-κεφάλαιον, -ου, τό [in LXX: [[ezekiel 13 18|Eze.13:18, 20]] (כֶּסֶת), I [[esther 3 8|Est.3:8]] * ;] a pillow, cushion: [[mark 4 38|Mrk.4:38.]]† (AS)
προσ-κληρόω, -ῶ to allot to, assign to by lot; pass. (but perh. as nid., EV, consorted with, so Syr.): [[acts 17 4|Act.17:4]] (for exx., v, Cremer, 749).† (AS)
πρόσ-κλισις, -εως, ἡ (προσκλίνω), inclination partiality: [[1-timothy 5 21|1Ti.5:21.]]† (AS)

προσ-κολλάω, -ῶ, [in LXX chiefly for דָּבַק ;] to glue to; pass., reflexive, to stick to, cleave to (Plat.): metaphorically (with dative, [[joshua 23 8|Jos.23:8]], Sir.6:34 al.), before πρός, [[mark 10 7|Mrk.10:7]] (R, txt.), [[ephesians 5 31|Eph.5:31]] (LXX).† (AS)

πρόσ-κομμα, -τος, τό (προσκόπτω), [in LXX: [[exodus 23 33|Exo.23:33 34:12]] (מוֹקֵשׁ), [[isaiah 8 14|Isa.8:14]] (נֶגֶף), Jdth.8:22, Sir.17:25, al. ;] (a) a stumble, stumbling: λίθος προσκόμματος (= נֶגֶף אֶבֶן, Isa, l.with), figuratively, [[romans 9 32|Rom.9:32-33]], [[1-peter 2 8|1Pe.2:8]]" (LXX) ; (b) = προσκοπή, an occasion of stumbling, a stumbling-block: metaphorically, [[romans 14 13|Rom.14:13, 20]], [[1-corinthians 8 9|1Co.8:9]] (Plut.).† SYN.: σκάνδαλον (cf. Cremer, 752 f.) (AS)
προσκοπή, -ῆς, ή (προσκόπτω), [in Gr. Ven.: [[proverbs 16 18|Pro.16:18]] (כִּשָּׁלוֹן) * ;] an occasion of stumbling, offence: [[2-corinthians 6 3|2Co.6:3.]]† (AS)

προσ-κόπτω [in LXX for נָגַף, כָּשַׁל ni., etc. ;] 1. trans., to strike (e.g. hand or foot) against: with accusative before πρός, figuratively, [[matthew 4 6|Mat.4:6]], [[luke 4 11|Luk.4:11]], (LXX) 2. Intrans., to stumble: absol. (Tob.11:9, [[proverbs 3 23|Pro.3:23]]), [[john 11 9|Jhn.11:9-10]]; of wind, to rush against, beat upon: with dative, [[matthew 7 27|Mat.7:27.]] Metaphorical, in late writers, (a) to offend (Polyb.); (b) to take offence at, stumble at: before ἐν, [[romans 14 21|Rom.14:21;]] with dative, τ. λόγῳ, [[1-peter 2 8|1Pe.2:8;]] τ. λίθῳ τ. προσκόμματος, [[romans 9 32|Rom.9:32.]]† (AS)
προσ-κυλίω to roll up, roll to: with accusative and dative, [[matthew 27 60|Mat.27:60;]] accusative before ἐπί, [[mark 15 46|Mrk.15:46.]]† (AS)

προσ-κυνέω, -ῶ (κυνέω, to kiss), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁחָה hith. ;] to make obeisance, do reverence to, worship; (a) prop. (as in cl., of the gods: Hdt., Æsch., Plat., al.), of God, Christ and supra-mundane beings: absol., [[john 4 20|Jhn.4:20 12:20]], [[acts 8 27|Act.8:27 24:11]], [[hebrews 11 21|Heb.11:21]] (Westc., in l), [[revelation 11 1|Rev.11:1;]] πίπτειν καὶ π., [[revelation 5 14|Rev.5:14;]] with dative (of the significance of this constr. as com­pared with the usual cl., with accusative, see Abbott, JG, 78 f.; JV, 133 ff.), [[john 4 21|Jhn.4:21, 23]], [[acts 7 43|Act.7:43]], [[1-corinthians 14 25|1Co.14:25]], [[hebrews 1 6|Heb.1:6]], [[revelation 4 10|Rev.4:10 7:11 11:16 13:4, 15 14:7 16:2 19:4, 10 19:20 22:8-9]]; with accusative (see supr.), [[matthew 4 10|Mat.4:10]], [[luke 4 8|Luk.4:8 24:52]] (WH, R, mg., om.), [[john 4 22|Jhn.4:22, 24]], [[revelation 9 20|Rev.9:20 13:4, 8 13:12 14:9, 11 20:4]]; Seq. ἐπώπιον, [[luke 4 7|Luk.4:7]], [[revelation 15 4|Rev.15:4]]; (b) as in cl., of homage to human superiors (cf. MM, xxi): absol., [[matthew 20 20|Mat.20:20]], [[acts 10 25|Act.10:25]]; with dative (see supr.), [[matthew 2 2|Mat.2:2, 8 8:2 9:18 14:33 15:25 18:26 28:9]], [[mark 15 19|Mrk.15:19]], [[john 9 38|Jhn.9:38]]; πεσὼν., [[matthew 2 11|Mat.2:11 4:9]]; ἐνώπιον τ. ποδῶν, [[revelation 3 9|Rev.3:9;]] with accusative, [[mark 5 6|Mrk.5:6]] (dative T).† (AS)
προσ-κυνητήν, -οῦ, ὁ (προσκυνέω), a worshipper: [[john 4 23|Jhn.4:23.]]† (AS)
προσ-λαλέω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[exodus 4 16|Exo.4:16]] AB2 (דָבַר pi.), Wis.13:17 * ;] to speak to: [[acts 28 20|Act.28:20;]] with dative of person(s), [[acts 13 43|Act.13:43.]]† (AS)

προσ-λαμβάνω [in LXX: [[psalms 18 16|Psa.18:16]] (מָשָׁה hi.), [[psalms 73 24|Psa.73:24]] (לָקַח), etc. ;] 1. to take in addition. 2. to take to oneself, take, receive; in NT always mid., -ομαι; (a) of things: of food, with accusative, [[acts 27 33|Act.27:33;]] with genitive part., [[acts 27 36|Act.27:36;]] (b) of persons: with accusative, [[matthew 16 22|Mat.16:22]], [[mark 8 32|Mrk.8:32]] (see Swete, in l), [[acts 17 5|Act.17:5 18:26 28:2]], [[romans 14 1|Rom.14:1, 3 15:7]], Phm 17.† (AS)
πρόσ-λημψις (Rec. -ληψις, as in Att..), -εως, ἡ (προσλαμβάνω), 1. an assumption (Plat.). 2. a receiving (cf. προσλαμβάνω): [[romans 11 15|Rom.11:15]],† (AS)

προσ-μένω [in LXX: [[judges 3 25|Jdg.3:25]] A (חוּל hi.), Tob.2:2 א, Wis.3:9, 3Ma.7:17 * ;] 1. to wait longer, continue, remain still: [[acts 18 18|Act.18:18;]] before ἐν, [[1-timothy 1 3|1Ti.1:3.]] 2. C. dative, to remain with: [[matthew 15 32|Mat.15:32]], [[mark 8 32|Mrk.8:32]]. Metaphorical, to remain attached to, cleave unto, abide in: τ. κυρίῳ, [[acts 11 23|Act.11:23]] (R, txt.; ἐν τ. κ., R, mg., see supr.); τ. χάριτι τ. θεοῦ, [[acts 13 43|Act.13:43;]] τ. δεήσεσιν, [[1-timothy 5 5|1Ti.5:5.]]† (AS)
προσ-ορμίζω (ὅρμος, an anchorage), to bring a ship to anchor at; usually in mid., to come to anchor near, and so pass. in late writers (Ael., Dio Cass.): [[mark 6 53|Mrk.6:53.]]† (AS)

to owe besides or still , (Thucydides): absolute, προσοφείλοντας ἡμᾶς ἐνέγραψεν (Demosthenes Orator):—;Pass. to be still owing, be still due , (Thucydides); so, ἡ ἔχθρη ἡ προσοφειλομένη ἐς Ἀθηναίους ἐκ τῶν Αἰγινητέων the hatred which was still due from the Aeginetans to the Athenians, i. e. their ancient feud, (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

προσ-οχθίζω [in LXX: [[leviticus 26 15|Lev.26:15]], al. (גָּעַל); [[leviticus 18 25|Lev.18:25]], al. (קוֹא), [[psalms 95 10|Psa.95:10]], [[ezekiel 36 31|Eze.36:31]] (קוּט), Sir.6:25, al. (other writers use ὀχθέω, rarely -ίζω) ;] to be angry with: with dative, [[hebrews 3 10|Heb.3:10]] (LXX), [[hebrews 3 17|Heb.3:17.]]† (AS)
πρόσπεινος, -ον (πεῖωα, hunger), hungry: [[acts 10 10|Act.10:10.]]† (AS)
προσ-πήγνυμι to fasten to: absol., to crucify, [[acts 2 23|Act.2:23.]]† (AS)

προσ-πίπτω [in LXX for נָפַל, נָגַע hi., כָּרַע ;] 1. to fall upon, strike against: with dative, of wind, [[matthew 7 25|Mat.7:25.]] 2. to fall down at one's feet, fall prostrate before: absol., before πρός, [[mark 7 25|Mrk.7:25;]] with dative of person(s), [[mark 3 11|Mrk.3:11 5:33]], [[luke 8 28|Luk.8:28]], [[acts 16 29|Act.16:29]]; τ. γόνασιν, [[luke 5 8|Luk.5:8.]]† (AS)

προσ-ποιέω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[1-samuel 21 13|1Ki.21:13]] (14) (הָלַל hithpo.), [[job 19 14|Job.19:14]], (Sir 34:30 (Sir.31:30)), Dan LXX Su 1:11 * ;] to make over to, add or attach to. Mid., to take to oneself, claim; hence, to pretend; with inf. (cf. Xen., Anab., iv, 3, 20), to make as if: [[luke 24 28|Luk.24:28.]]† (AS)
προσ-πορεύομαι [in LXX for קָרַב, נָגַשׁ, etc. ;] to come near, approach: with dative of person(s), [[mark 10 35|Mrk.10:35.]]† (AS)

προσ-ρήγνυμι [in Aq.: [[psalms 2 9|Psa.2:9]] * ;] to break against, dash against; (a) trans. (παιδία πέτραις, FlJ, Ant., ix, 4, 6); (b) intrans., with dative: [[luke 6 48|Luk.6:48-49]] (cf. προσπίπτω).† (AS)

προσ-τάσσω [in LXX chiefly for צָוָה pi. ;] 1. with accusative of person(s), to place at, to attach to. 2. to give a command, enjoin, appoint: [[luke 5 14|Luk.5:14;]] with dative of person(s), [[matthew 1 24|Mat.1:24;]] with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 8 4|Mat.8:4]], [[mark 1 44|Mrk.1:44]]; with accusative and inf., [[acts 10 48|Act.10:48;]] pass., [[acts 10 33|Act.10:33 17:26]].† (AS)
προστάτις, -ιδος, ἡ (fem, of προοτάτης), a patroness, protectress: [[romans 16 2|Rom.16:2.]]† (AS)

προσ-τίθημι [in LXX chiefly for יָסַף hi., also for אָסַף ni., etc. ;] 1. to put to. 2. to add, join to, give in addition: with accusative before ἐπί, [[matthew 6 27|Mat.6:27]], [[luke 3 20|Luk.3:20 12:25]]; ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό, [[acts 2 47|Act.2:47;]] with accusative and dative, [[luke 17 5|Luk.17:5]], [[hebrews 12 19|Heb.12:19]] (see MM, xxi); pass., absol., [[acts 2 41|Act.2:41]], [[galatians 3 19|Gal.3:19]]; with dative, [[matthew 6 33|Mat.6:33]], [[mark 4 24|Mrk.4:24]], [[luke 12 31|Luk.12:31]], [[acts 5 14|Act.5:14 11:24]]; προσιτέθη πρὸς τ. πατέρας (cf. [[genesis 26 8|Gen.26:8]], [[judges 2 10|Jdg.2:10]], al.), [[acts 13 36|Act.13:36]]; with inf., of repeating or continuing the action signified by the following verb, as in Heb. idiom ([[genesis 4 2|Gen.4:2 8:12]], al.; cf. WM, § 54, 5; Lft. on Clem., 1Co., xii; but see also M, Pr., 67, 233; Deiss., BS, 67.1; MM, xxi), [[luke 20 11|Luk.20:11]], [[acts 12 3|Act.12:3]]; similarly ptcp., προσ-θείς, with indic. ([[genesis 38 5|Gen.38:5]], al.), [[luke 19 11|Luk.19:11]].† (AS)
προσ-τρέχω [in LXX for רוּץ ;] to run to: [[mark 9 15|Mrk.9:15 10:17]], [[acts 8 30|Act.8:30]].† (AS)

προσφάγιον, -ου, τό (φαγεῖν), Hellenistic for ὄψον ὀψάριον) a relish or dainty (esp, cooked fish), to be eaten with bread: [[john 21 5|Jhn.21:5]] (have ye taken any fish, Field, Notes, 109; Abbott, Essays, 105; cf. M, Pr., 170n; MM, Exp., xxi).† (AS)

πρόσφατος, -ον (on the derivation, see Boisacq, see word and cf. -ως), [in LXX: [[numbers 6 3|Num.6:3]] (לַח), [[deuteronomy 32 17|Deu.32:17]], [[ecclesiastes 1 9|Ecc.1:9]] (חָדָשׁ), [[psalms 81 9|Psa.81:9]] (זוּר), Sir.9:10 * ;] 1. originally, freshly slain. 2. Generally (from Æsch. on), new, fresh, recent: ὁδός, [[hebrews 10 20|Heb.10:20]] (see MM, Exp., xxi; Rutherford, NPhr., 471 f.).† (AS)

προσφάτως adv. (see: πρόσφατος), [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 24 5|Deu.24:5]] (חָדָשׁ), Jdth.4:3, 5, [[ezekiel 11 3|Eze.11:3]], 2Ma.14:36 2Mac 14:16 ;] recently: [[acts 18 2|Act.18:2]] (see MM, Exp., xxi).† (AS)

προσ-φέρω [in LXX chiefly for קָרַב hi. ;] 1. to bring to, lead to: with accusative and dative of person(s), [[matthew 4 24|Mat.4:24 8:16 9:2, 32 14:35 17:16]], [[mark 2 4|Mrk.2:4]] (WH, R, txt.; sc. αὐτόν) [[mark 10 13|Mrk.10:13]], [[luke 18 15|Luk.18:15 23:14]]; pass., [[matthew 12 22|Mat.12:22]] (act., WH, txt.) [[matthew 18 24|Mat.18:24]] (προσήχθη, WH) [[matthew 19 13|Mat.19:13;]] with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 25 20|Mat.25:20;]] id. with dative of person(s), [[matthew 22 19|Mat.22:19]], [[luke 23 36|Luk.23:36]]; τ. στόματι, [[john 19 29|Jhn.19:29;]] metaphorically, with dative of person(s), to deal with, [[hebrews 12 7|Heb.12:7]] (cl.). 2. to offer: [[matthew 2 11|Mat.2:11]], [[acts 8 18|Act.8:18]]; esp. (as frequently in LXX; cf. FlJ, Ant., iii, 9, 3) sacrifices, gifts and prayers to God: absol., before περί (ὑπέρ), [[mark 1 44|Mrk.1:44]], [[luke 5 14|Luk.5:14]], [[hebrews 5 1|Heb.5:1, 3 9:7 10:12]]; pass., [[acts 21 26|Act.21:26;]] with accusative of thing(s) (δῶρον, θυσίαν, λυτρείαν, προσφοράν), [[matthew 5 23|Mat.5:23-24]] (aoristic pres.; M, Pr., 247) [[matthew 8 4|Mat.8:4]], [[john 16 2|Jhn.16:2]], [[acts 7 42|Act.7:42 21:26]], [[hebrews 5 1|Heb.5:1 8:3-4 9:7, 9 10:1-2, 8 10:11-12]]; δεήσεις τε κ. ἱκετηρίας, [[hebrews 5 7|Heb.5:7;]] with accusative of person(s), [[hebrews 11 17|Heb.11:17]] (conative impf.; M, Pr., 129); of Christ, [[hebrews 7 27|Heb.7:27]] (ἀνενέγκας, WH, txt.) [[hebrews 9 14|Heb.9:14, 25 9:28]].† (AS)

προσφιλής, -ές (φιλέω), [in LXX: [[esther 5 1|Est.5:1]], Sir.4:7 20:13 * ;] (a) of persons, in both act, and pass. sense (LXX, ll. with); (b) of things, pleas­ing, agreeable (EV, lovely): [[philippians 4 8|Php.4:8.]]† (AS)

προσ-φορά, -ᾶς, ἡ (προσφέρω), [in LXX: [[1-kings 7 48|3Ki.7:48]] (פָּנִים) [[psalms 40 6|Psa.40:6]] (מִנְחָה), I [[esther 5 52|Est.5:52]], Sir.14:11, al. ;] 1. a bringing to, offering (Plat., al.). 2. (Less frequently in cl.), a present, an offering; in NT, of sacrificial offerings: [[acts 21 26|Act.21:26 24:17]], [[ephesians 5 2|Eph.5:2]], [[hebrews 10 5|Heb.10:5, 8 10:14]]; περί ἀμαρτίας, [[hebrews 10 18|Heb.10:18;]] with genitive obj., [[romans 15 16|Rom.15:16]], [[hebrews 10 10|Heb.10:10]].† (AS)

προσ-φωνέω, -ῶ [in LXX: 1Es.2:21 [[esther 6 6|Est.6:6]] [[esther 6 22|Est.6:22]], 2Ma.15:15 * ;] 1. to address, call to; in cl., with accusative of person(s), with dupl. accusative (cf. 2Mac, l.with); absol. (Hom., Od., v, 159, al.): [[acts 21 40|Act.21:40]] In late writers, with dative of person(s): [[matthew 11 16|Mat.11:16]], [[luke 7 32|Luk.7:32 13:12 23:20]], [[acts 22 2|Act.22:2]]. 2. to call by name, summon: with accusative (as in cl.), [[luke 6 13|Luk.6:13.]]† (AS)
πρόσ-χυσις, -εως, ἡ a pouring or sprinkling upon: [[hebrews 11 28|Heb.11:28.]]† (AS)
προσ-ψαύω in poët. and late writers, to touch: with dative, [[luke 11 46|Luk.11:46.]]† (AS)
προσωπολημπτέω (Rec. -ληπτ-), -ῶ (-λήμπτης, which see), to have respect of persons: [[james 2 9|Jas.2:9.]]† (AS)

προσωπο-λήμπτης (Rec. -λήπτης, see Bl., § 6, 8), -ου, ὁ (πρόσωπον λαμβάνειν, see: πρόσωπον), a respecter of persons: [[acts 10 34|Act.10:34]] (on this group of cognate forms, see Mayor, da., 78 f.; and cf. Thackeray, Gr., 44).† (AS)

προσωπολημψία (Rec. -ληψία), -ας, ἡ (προσωπολήμπτης) respect of persons: [[romans 2 11|Rom.2:11]], [[ephesians 6 9|Eph.6:9]], [[colossians 3 25|Col.3:25]], [[james 2 1|Jas.2:1]] (see Mayor, in l).† (AS)

πρόσωπον, -ου, τό (πρός, ὤψ), [in LXX chiefly and very frequently for פָּנִים ;] 1. prop., of persons (so always in cl.); (a) the face, countenance: [[matthew 6 16|Mat.6:16-17]], [[mark 14 65|Mrk.14:65]], [[luke 9 29|Luk.9:29]], [[2-corinthians 3 7|2Co.3:7]], [[revelation 4 7|Rev.4:7]], al.; τὸ π. τῆς γενέτεως (EV, natural face), [[james 1 23|Jas.1:23;]] πίπτειν ἐπὶ (τὰ) π., [[matthew 17 6|Mat.17:6]], [[luke 5 12|Luk.5:12]], [[revelation 7 11|Rev.7:11]], al.; ἀγνοούμενος τῷ π., [[galatians 1 22|Gal.1:22;]] π., οὐ καρδίᾳ, [[1-thessalonians 2 17|1Th.2:17;]] κατὰ πρόσωπον (in front, facing: Thuc., Xen., al.), when present, face to face, [[acts 25 16|Act.25:16]], [[2-corinthians 10 1|2Co.10:1 10:7]], [[galatians 2 11|Gal.2:11]]; id. with genitive, as compound prep., in the presence of (not cl.; see Bl., § 40, 9; M, Pr., 99 f.; Thackeray, Gr., 43 f.), [[luke 2 31|Luk.2:31]], [[acts 3 13|Act.3:13]]; similarly ἀπὸ π. (Heb. (פָּנִים מִלִּפְּנֵי); see Dalman, Words, 29), from the presence of, [[acts 3 19|Act.3:19 5:41 7:45]], [[2-thessalonians 1 9|2Th.1:9]], [[revelation 12 14|Rev.12:14 20:11]]; πρὸ π. (Heb. (פָּנִים לִפְנֵי), before, [[matthew 11 10|Mat.11:10]], [[mark 1 2|Mrk.1:2]], [[luke 7 27|Luk.7:27]]" (LXX), al.; in other phrases resembling Heb. idiom (Thackeray, Gr., 42), βλέπειν (ὁρᾶν, θεωρεῖν, ἰδεῖν) τὸ π., to see one's face, i.e. see him in person, [[matthew 18 10|Mat.18:10]], [[acts 20 25|Act.20:25, 38]], [[1-thessalonians 3 10|1Th.3:10]], [[revelation 22 4|Rev.22:4]]; ἐμφανισθῆναι τῷ π. τοῦ θεοῦ, [[hebrews 9 24|Heb.9:24;]] ἐν π. Χριστοῦ, [[2-corinthians 2 10|2Co.2:10 4:6]]; μετὰ τοῦ π. σου with thy presence, [[acts 2 28|Act.2:28]] (LXX); εἰς π. τῶν ἐκκλησιῶν, [[2-corinthians 8 24|2Co.8:24;]] στηρίζειν τὸ π. (Heb. פָּנִים שׂוּם: [[jeremiah 21 10|Jer.21:10]], al.; see Dalman, Words, 30), with inf., to set one's face towards, [[luke 9 51|Luk.9:51;]] similarly, τὸ π. αὐτοῦ ἦν πορευόμενον (op. cit., 31), [[luke 9 53|Luk.9:53;]] τὸ π. τοῦ κυρίου ἐπί, [[1-peter 3 12|1Pe.3:12]] (LXX) (b) form, person: καυχᾶσθαι. ἐν π. καὶ μὴ ἐν καρδίᾳ, [[2-corinthians 5 12|2Co.5:12]] (cf. [[1-samuel 16 7|1Ki.16:7]]); metaphorically, as in Heb. idiom, of judgment according to appearance, external condition or circumstances (פָּנִים H5387; see Dalman, Words, 30; Thackeray, Gr., 43 f.): λαμβάνειν π., [[luke 20 21|Luk.20:21]], [[galatians 2 6|Gal.2:6]]; βλέπειν εἰς π., [[matthew 22 16|Mat.22:16]], [[mark 12 14|Mrk.12:14]]; θαυμάζειν πρόσωπα, Ju 16. 2. Of things (cf. Dalman, l.with) (a) face, appearance ([[psalms 104 30|Psa.104:30]]): [[matthew 16 3|Mat.16:3]] (WH, R, mg., om.), [[luke 12 56|Luk.12:56]], [[james 1 11|Jas.1:11]] (b) surface ([[genesis 2 6|Gen.2:6]]): [[luke 21 35|Luk.21:35]], [[acts 17 26|Act.17:26]] (AS)
προ-τάσσω [in LXX: 2Ma.8:36 R (Α, προστ-) * ;] 1. to place in front. 2. to arrange beforehand: [[acts 17 26|Act.17:26]], Rec. (for προστ., Edd.).† (AS)
προ-τείνω, [in LXX: 2Ma_7:1-42, 3Ma_2:1 * ;] to stretch out, stretch forth: of preparations for scourging (see Field, Notes, 136 f.), [[acts 22 25|Act.22:25.]]† (AS)
before; (adv.) before, formerly, an earlier time former, prior, [[ephesians 4 22|Eph. 4:22;]] before, former, prior, [[ephesians 4 22|Eph. 4:22;]] before, formerly, [[john 6 62|Jn. 6:62]]

A. Compar., πρότερος, -α, -ον, [in LXX for רִאשׁוֹן ,לִפָנִים, etc. ;] before, of time, place, rank, etc.; in NT always of Time, before, former: [[ephesians 4 22|Eph.4:22.]] Adverbially, πρότερον, before, aforetime, formerly: [[john 7 50|Jhn.7:50]], [[2-corinthians 1 15|2Co.1:15]], [[hebrews 4 6|Heb.4:6]]; opposite to ἔπειτα, [[hebrews 7 27|Heb.7:27;]] τὸ π., [[john 6 62|Jhn.6:62 9:8]], [[galatians 4 13|Gal.4:13]], [[1-timothy 1 13|1Ti.1:13]]; αἱ π. ἡμέραι, [[hebrews 10 32|Heb.10:32;]] αἱ π. ἐπιθυμίαι, [[1-peter 1 14|1Pe.1:14.]]† (AS)

προ-τίθημι [in LXX: [[exodus 40 4|Exo.40:4, 23]], [[leviticus 24 8|Lev.24:8]] (עָרַךְ) [[psalms 54 3|Psa.54:3]] (שׂוּם), etc. ;] 1. to set before, set forth publicly; so also in mid.: with accusative of person(s), [[romans 3 25|Rom.3:25]] (for a suggested alt, rend., see MM, xxii). 2. Mid., to set before oneself, propose, purpose: with inf., [[romans 1 13|Rom.1:13;]] with accusative of thing(s), [[ephesians 1 9|Eph.1:9.]]† (AS)
προ-τρέπω [in LXX: Wis.14:18, 2Ma.11:7, 4Ma.12:7 4Mac 15:12 4Mac 16:13 * ;] to urge forwards, exhort, persuade. Mid., in same sense (as also in cl.): [[acts 18 27|Act.18:27.]]† (AS)

προ-τρέχω [in LXX: [[1-samuel 8 11|1Ki.8:11]] (פָּנִים רוּץ), [[job 41 13|Job.41:13]] (14) A (דּוּץ), Tob.11:3 (before ἔμπροσθεν), 1Ma.16:21 * ;] 1. to run forward. 2. to run on, run in advance: [[john 20 4|Jhn.20:4;]] before εἰς τὸ ἔμπροσθεν, [[luke 19 4|Luk.19:4.]]† (AS)
προ-ϋπ-άρχω [in LXX: [[job 42 18|Job 42:18]]* ;] 1. to be beforehand in. 2. to be before or previously: with ptcp., [[luke 23 12|Luk.23:12]], [[acts 8 9|Act.8:9]].† (AS)

πρό-φασις, -εως, ἡ (φήμι), [in LXX: [[psalms 141 4|Psa.141:4]] (עֲלִילָה), ??עֲלִילָה), ??[[daniel 6 4|Dan.6:4-5]](5-6) (עִלָּה) [[proverbs 18 1|Pro.18:1]], [[hosea 10 4|Hos.10:4]] * ;] a pretence, pretext: [[matthew 23 1|Mat.23:1]] (WM, R, txt., om.), [[mark 12 40|Mrk.12:40]], [[luke 20 47|Luk.20:47]] [[john 15 22|Jhn.15:22]], [[acts 27 30|Act.27:30]], [[philippians 1 18|Php.1:18]], [[1-thessalonians 2 5|1Th.2:5]].† (AS)
προφέρω [in LXX: [[proverbs 10 13|Pro.10:13]] (מָצָא ni.), Tob.9:5, al. ;] to bring forth: with accusative of thing(s), before ἐκ, [[luke 6 45|Luk.6:45.]]† (AS)

προφητεία, -ας, ἡ (προψητεύω) [in LXX for נְבוּאָה, חָזוֹן ;] the gift (and its exercise) of interpreting the Divine will and purpose, prophecy, prophesying: of OT prophecy, [[matthew 13 14|Mat.13:14]], [[2-peter 1 20|2Pe.1:20-21]]; of NT prophecy, [[romans 12 6|Rom.12:6]], [[1-corinthians 12 10|1Co.12:10 13:2 14:6 14:22]], [[1-timothy 4 14|1Ti.4:14]], [[revelation 11 6|Rev.11:6 22:19]]; pl., [[1-corinthians 13 8|1Co.13:8]], [[1-thessalonians 5 20|1Th.5:20]], [[1-timothy 1 18|1Ti.1:18]]; οἱ λόγοι τῆς π., [[revelation 1 3|Rev.1:3 22:7, 10 22:18]]; τ. πνεῦμα τῆς π., [[revelation 19 10|Rev.19:10]] (Luc., FlJ, LXX, π.; see Deiss., BS, 235 f.; MM, xxii).† (AS)

προφητεύω (προφήτης), [in LXX chiefly for נָבָא ni., hith. ;] to be a προφήτης (which see), to prophesy: in the primary sense of telling forth the Divine counsels, [[matthew 7 22|Mat.7:22 26:68]], [[mark 14 65|Mrk.14:65]], [[luke 1 67|Luk.1:67 22:64]], [[acts 19 6|Act.19:6]], [[1-corinthians 11 4|1Co.11:4-5 13:9 14:1 14:3-5 14:24 14:31 14:39]], [[hebrews 11 3|Heb.11:3]]; with the idea of foretelling future events (an idea merely incidental, not essential; see Lft., Notes, 83 f.), [[matthew 11 13|Mat.11:13]], [[acts 2 17|Act.2:17-18]]" (LXX) [[acts 21 9|Act.21:9;]] before περί, [[matthew 15 7|Mat.15:7]], [[mark 7 6|Mrk.7:6]], [[1-peter 1 10|1Pe.1:10]]; ἐπί, with dative, [[revelation 10 11|Rev.10:11;]] λέγων, Ju 14; ὅτι, [[john 11 51|Jhn.11:51.]]† SYN.: μαντεύομαι, q.v (AS)

προφήτης, -ου, ὁ [πρόφημι, to speak forth), [in LXX chiefly for נָבִיא ;] one who acts as an interpreter or forth-teller of the Divine will (see Lft., Notes, 83f.; Tr., Syn., §vi), a prophet; 1. in cl. (Æsch., Hdt., Plat., al.), of the interpreters of oracles. 2. In NT, (a) of the OT prophets: [[matthew 5 12|Mat.5:12]], [[mark 6 15|Mrk.6:15]], [[luke 4 27|Luk.4:27]], [[john 8 52|Jhn.8:52]], [[romans 11 3|Rom.11:3]], al.; (b) of prophets in general: [[matthew 10 41|Mat.10:41 13:57 21:46]], [[mark 6 4|Mrk.6:4]], [[luke 13 33|Luk.13:33]], al.; (with) of John the Baptist: [[matthew 21 26|Mat.21:26]], [[mark 6 15|Mrk.6:15]], [[luke 1 76|Luk.1:76]]; (d) of Christ: [[matthew 21 11|Mat.21:11]], [[john 6 14|Jhn.6:14]], [[acts 3 22|Act.3:22, 23 7:37]]" (LXX) ; (e) of Christian prophets in the apostolic age: [[acts 15 32|Act.15:32]], [[1-corinthians 12 28|1Co.12:28]], [[ephesians 2 20|Eph.2:20]], al.; (f) by meton., of the writings of prophets: [[luke 24 27|Luk.24:27]], [[acts 8 28|Act.8:28]], al.; (g) of a poet: [[titus 1 12|Tit.1:12]] (on the use of the term in π. and Inscr., see Deiss., BS, 235f.; MM, xxii). (AS)
προφητικός, -ά, -όν (προφήτης), of prophecy, prophetic: [[romans 16 26|Rom.16:26]], [[2-peter 1 19|2Pe.1:19]].† (AS)

προφῆτις, -ιδος, ἡ fem, of προφήτης, [in LXX: [[exodus 15 20|Exo.15:20]], [[judges 4 4|Jdg.4:4]], [[2-kings 22 14|4Ki.22:14]], [[2-chronicles 34 22|2Ch.34:22]], [[isaiah 8 3|Isa.8:3]] (נְבִיאָה) * ;] a prophetess: [[luke 2 36|Luk.2:36]], [[revelation 2 20|Rev.2:20]].† (AS)
προ-φθάνω [in LXX chiefly for קָדַם pi. ;] with ptcp. (as in cl., but more frequently the simple φθάνω, which see), to anticipate: [[matthew 17 25|Mat.17:25.]]† (AS)
